goal: Add a headless Host session runner that reads completion only from checkable evidence and bind the agent-backed handlers (analyze_codebase, triage_issue, draft_plan, publish_plan_for_approval, enroll_and_drive with tracker_approval or policy_auto under the standing run process, repair_pr_ci, repair_pr_conflict, address_pr_review, owner replan and approve) to the S8 dispatch core, under S9 (D11) of docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source GAP-1, GAP-5 and GAP-6; meet S9 and D11 items 1-3 and 5 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md (SCN-6): with a fake session provider and GitHub fixtures, successive ticks of the standing run process carry a new Issue through analyze_codebase, draft_plan via imm-kernel intent author, plan summary publication, a REST-read /approve <digest> comment turned into a tracker_approval_proof, enrollTask, dispatchLoopDrive() to settlement with the Executor exit recorded, and open_pr on imm/<slug>; sessions receive only the daemon's GitHub credential.

Source GAP-5, GAP-6 and GAP-12; meet D11 items 1, 3 and 4 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md: an approval with a stale digest, an edited comment, or a daemon-authored comment does not enroll; a one-shot tick records requires_standing_daemon instead of driving a Lane; a session that exits without its expected output file, Git head, or validation result is recorded failed regardless of its output text; repair handlers keep the S7 two-attempt cap; and a review comment whose path is outside the TaskIntent scope_hint escalates instead of being applied.
